datasets.label: Food composition
datasets.description: Realistic synthetic food spectra with broad NIR bands, scattering, baseline variation and instrument noise; protein percentage is the response.
datasets.provenance: Deterministic nirs4all SyntheticNIRSGenerator recipe (realistic complexity, seed 101); 90 calibration and 30 untouched validation samples.

datasets.label: Grain starch
datasets.description: Realistic synthetic grain spectra with recognisable NIR absorption bands, baseline variation, scattering and instrument noise; starch percentage is the response.
datasets.provenance: Deterministic nirs4all SyntheticNIRSGenerator recipe (realistic complexity, seed 713); 90 calibration and 30 untouched validation samples.

datasets.label: Multi-batch process
datasets.description: A four-batch process example with batch offsets, scattering and environmental variation superimposed on recognisable NIR absorption bands; water percentage is the response.
datasets.provenance: Deterministic nirs4all SyntheticNIRSGenerator recipe (realistic complexity, four batches, seed 303); 90 calibration and 30 untouched validation samples.
